run_atari_dataset_example: run the atari_example script to load an Atari dataset and print data specs using --path and --game flags
create_atari_dataset: create a TensorFlow dataset from Atari replay buffers using atari.dataset with path, game, and shard parameters
build_atari_environment: build an Atari gym environment for a given game using atari.environment and inspect its observation space
inspect_data_spec: inspect the dtype and shape of Atari dataset samples using tree.map_structure on sample data
get_environment_spec: get the environment spec for an Atari game using acme specs.make_environment_spec on the environment object
